voiceSummary: Avanti Feeds Limited published its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in the Financial Express and Andhra Prabha on November 11, 2026. MPS Limited issued a postal ballot notice seeking member approval for the re-appointment of Olvy Verma as non-executive independent director. The remote e-voting period commenced on November 12, 2026, and ends on December 11, 2026. The cut-off date for voting rights was November 6, 2026. R. Sridharan has been appointed as the scrutinizer. The voting results and scrutinizer's report will be announced by December 15, 2026. National General Industries Limited also filed its un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Avanti Feeds Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Avanti Feeds Limited reported unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 10, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 1,75,251.89 lakhs. Net profit for the quarter was Rs. 7,391.52 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 5.06. For the half year, revenue from operations was Rs. 3,65,238.36 lakhs. Net profit for the half year was Rs. 19,022.02 lakhs. Earnings per share for the half year was Rs. 12.64. The Limited Review Report was issued by statutory auditors Tukaram & Co LLP. The financial results are available on the company website.
